acip: GANG ZAG GI BDAG 'DZIN DANG, DE LAS BYUNG BA'I NYON MONGS RNAMS NYON MONGS CAN GYI SGRIB PA YIN LA, DE DAG GI BAG CHAGS DANG, DE'I DBANG GIS BYUNG BA'I GNAS NGAN LEN RNAMS NYON MONGS CAN MIN PA'O,,
wylie: gang zag gi bdag 'dzin dang, de las byung ba'i nyon mongs rnams nyon mongs can gyi sgrib pa yin la, de dag gi bag chags dang, de'i dbang gis byung ba'i gnas ngan len rnams nyon mongs can min pa'o
english: Obstacles related to negative emotions would be described as the tendency to believe that there is a self-nature to the person; as well as all the negative emotions that this tendency engenders.  The mental seeds for both of these, as well as subtle residual negativities, are considered examples of obstacles not related to negative emotions.
